name: Burnside 20
flavor: East-west workhorse. Somebody always pulls the cord one stop too late.

name: Barbur 12
flavor: Hills, rain, and a view of downtown if the windows are not fogged.

name: Belmont 15
flavor: Coffee cups, strollers, and a sudden stop for a fox on Division.

name: Martin Luther King 6
flavor: Northbound through a corridor of murals and MAX shadows.

name: Fessenden 4
flavor: St. Johns steel and the longest way around the river.

name: FX2 Division
flavor: All-door boarding energy. The bus that thinks it is a train.

name: Gillig Low Floor
flavor: Kneel, ramp, beep. The everyday champion of curb cuts.

name: Accordion
flavor: The middle joint is a portal. Do not stand on the spinning plate.

name: Operator Wave
flavor: Two-finger salute at a layover. You are seen.

name: Please Hold On
flavor: The chime, then the lurch. Physics is undefeated.

name: Blue Line Spine
flavor: Hillsboro to Gresham. The original long commute.

name: Red Line Runway
flavor: Airport carpet energy, but on rails.

name: Yellow Line North
flavor: Interstate Avenue in a straight shot. Expo vibes.

name: Green Line Clackamas
flavor: Mall, college, and a turnback that always feels sudden.

name: Orange Line Bridge
flavor: Tilikum lights, bike path below, river wind in the doors.

name: Type 1 Pioneer
flavor: High floors and history. The original MAX look.

name: Type 5 Low Floor
flavor: The train you actually ride. Yellow stripe optional in memory.

name: Pioneer Courthouse Square
flavor: Brick living room. Transfers, chess, and a fountain in summer.

name: Rose Quarter
flavor: Concert spillover and a MAX weave through the ramps.

name: Gateway Transit Center
flavor: Where lines braid. Bring a jacket; the wind knows this place.

name: Hollywood Transit Center
flavor: Rebuild scars and a hill that still surprises visitors.

name: Union Station
flavor: Go by train. The clock still means it.

name: Aerial Tram Shadow
flavor: Not TriMet, but every rider looks up anyway.

name: WES Commuter
flavor: Weekday-only folklore. If you catch it, you brag.

name: WES
flavor: A train that sounds like a bus until it does not.

name: NS Line Loop
flavor: Pearl to South Waterfront. Tourists and grocery bags.

name: Hop Echo
flavor: Tap remembered. The beep is a tiny win.

name: November Window
flavor: Condensation art. You draw a route map with a sleeve.

name: Steel Bridge Lift
flavor: The whole network holds its breath for a barge.

name: Last Bus
flavor: The 2 a.m. fluorescent quiet. You and the operator and the river.

name: Proof of Payment
flavor: A polite scan. Your collection is the real ticket.

name: Front Rack
flavor: Two bikes, one prayer, a hill start.

name: City of Roses
flavor: Every ride is a stamp. The album is the map.

name: Steel Whisper
flavor: When the train takes the curve and the city lights smear.
